result.summary: The main visual issue is a layout/content error involving a large, featureless promotional card at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The large card at the bottom of the screen is missing all restaurant information (name, rating, delivery time, price). Only the '-20%' badge is visible.
issues.suggestion: Populate the card with necessary metadata (restaurant name, delivery details) to make it actionable and informative for the user.

issues.description: The category chips ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', etc.) lack sufficient visual distinction to indicate that they are interactable filters.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or hover state/active indicator to emphasize the interactive nature of the category chips.
